alexa_knox: Heads-up — Velora Health's daily token usage spiked yesterday and hit our soft quota. I'm recommending a proactive temporary quota bump to avoid throttling during onboarding. Details below. :warning:

matt_hensley: Agreed, saw the spike. What's the proposed bump and duration?

alexa_knox: Propose +100k tokens/day for 14 days, then revert to current + monitor. Current daily avg 40k -> peak 145k. This is a known onboarding flow.

ops_analytics: Confirmed. 3x spike at 2025-11-12T22:14Z. Error rate climbed from 0.3% to 1.8% during the surge, latency +30ms median.

ryan_dooley: I'll coordinate customer comms. Want to send a proactive note letting them know we're increasing quota and keep an eye on usage. Any legal/contract impact?

sara_park: Product OK with temporary bump. No contract changes needed. Just log the change and include rollback criteria.

alexa_knox: Proposed rollback criteria: sustained usage <= 55k/day for 5 days OR customer requests maintain. Owner: @matt_hensley to approve and run bump. Ops to monitor.

matt_hensley: I'll run it now. Command for infra team: ```/infra quota bump --account velora --type daily_tokens --amount 100000 --duration 14d --note "onboarding spike"``` Let me know if I should schedule throttling rules.

deploy-bot: infra job queued by matt_hensley: job_id=job_20251113_337

deploy-bot: infra job completed successfully in 12s — quota updated: velora daily_tokens +100000 for 14 days (expires 2025-11-27T15:12Z)

ops_analytics: Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/velora?view=quota_usage — set alert: >120k/day sustained 2 days.

alexa_knox: Draft outbound note for review: ```Hi Velora team — we've temporarily increased your daily token quota to prevent throttling while you complete onboarding. No action needed from you; we'll monitor and follow up in two weeks. Reach out if you'd like a permanent bump. — Alexa (Redwood CS)``` Thoughts?

ryan_dooley: Good. Add an optional line about cost impact: "This temporary increase won't change your bill unless you exceed committed usage; we'll surface any overage."

sara_park: Add a short bulleted FAQ link to our KB: https://docs.redwood.ai/kb/quota-bumps

alexa_knox: Great — @ryan_dooley will send at 16:00 PT today. I'll add notes to the customer record and schedule a 7-day check-in. :white_check_mark:

matt_hensley: Done — ticket #CS-1892 updated, and I'm tagging eng-runbook for rollback automation.

ops_analytics: Added alert rule and created dashboard share with velora CS owners. Will post weekly usage summary to this thread.

ryan_dooley: Sending outbound now. I'll paste copy and timestamp when sent.

ryan_dooley: (sent 2025-11-13T16:01Z) ```Slack DM / Email sent to Velora: [email content snippet identical to draft].``` :mailbox_with_mail:

alexa_knox: Thanks team. We'll re-check in next weekly account health sync unless anything unexpected pops up. :rocket:
